findings.issue: `MeasureTheory.Measure.mem_closure_of_tendsto_inter_closedBall_div`, `posTangentConeAt_eq_univ_of_tendsto_inter_closedBall_div` (311), `tangentConeAt_eq_univ_of_tendsto_inter_closedBall_div` (335), `uniqueDiffWithinAt_of_tendsto_inter_closedBall_div` (344), and `HasFDerivWithinAt.antilipschitzWith_of_tendsto_inter_closedBall_div` / `injective_of_tendsto_inter_closedBall_div` (365, 374) are generic Haar-measure + tangent-cone analysis results that use no Hausdorff measure or Euclidean volume normalization, so they do not belong in a Euclidean Hausdorff-density file; this also forces a new public import of FDeriv.ImageCone into Density.lean.

findings.evidence: code/TauCeti/Geometry/MeasureTheory/Rectifiable/Bilipschitz.lean:48 `theorem CountablyRectifiable.exists_bilipschitz_cover`; the new proof only calls `hEm.exists_measurable_subset_ae_eq` and `(hE.congr _).exists_bilipschitz_cover`.
findings.issue: `CountablyRectifiable.exists_bilipschitz_subset_cover` is a pure refinement of `CountablyRectifiable.exists_bilipschitz_cover` (patches inside E for null-measurable E) with no approximate-tangent content, and is reused by TangentialFDeriv.lean; it is misplaced in ApproximateTangent.

summary: General Haar-density/tangent-cone lemmas are placed in the Euclidean Hausdorff volume density file instead of the TangentCone directory, and a generic rectifiable bi-Lipschitz cover refinement sits in ApproximateTangent rather than next to the cover it refines.
